messages: so this science story i read - Maya tested if warm water makes fish eat more, but she changed the water temp AND the food AND the light all at the same time. that seems off right?
ok but my teacher said the report rubric wants me to explain WHY changing multiple things at once is a problem, not just that she did it. i dont get why it matters though, i never learned this
i mean the fish ate more so isnt that just proof warm water worked?
